title: Binary Tree: Count the Leaves
summary: Count the leaves (nodes with no children) recursively: a leaf counts 1, any other node counts the leaves of its two subtrees.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Values to insert (in order)
inputs.note: They are inserted into a binary search tree first: smaller values go left, others go right.

anchors.label: No children? It is a leaf

practice.note: The tree arrives as `root` (None or null when empty), built by inserting the values one at a time into a binary search tree (smaller goes left, equal or larger goes right). A TreeNode has `val`, `left` and `right`. Return how many nodes have no children.
